label: V0 baseline (enter at the next 5m open - production rule)
V1 wait for the setup (price trades back to the level, fill at the level, 12-bar expiry)
V1x wait for the setup with no expiry (to the 15:20 entry cut-off)
V2 wait for a rejection close at the level, then enter at the next open
V3 wait for the rejection close, then the retest of the level, fill at the level
V4 production no-chase re-anchor (any entry level, direction may flip) - reference only
